subtheme: Making language models and reasoning better with reinforcement learning

subsubthemes.name: Teaching language models to think step-by-step
subsubthemes.gist: These papers help language models solve harder problems by reinforcing how they reason and plan, making them better at multi-step thinking and abstract concepts.

subsubthemes.name: Making reinforcement learning training faster and cheaper
subsubthemes.gist: These papers speed up or reduce the cost of training language models with reinforcement learning, by using tricks like parallel processing, efficient data use, or smarter credit assignment.

subsubthemes.name: Designing better reward signals for learning
subsubthemes.gist: These papers solve the hard problem of telling a language model which outputs are actually good, using techniques like verifiable rewards, process rewards, or shaping from multiple views.

subsubthemes.name: Balancing trying new things versus sticking with what works
subsubthemes.gist: These papers tackle the tension between exploring new strategies and exploiting known good ones, preventing models from collapsing into narrow or overfitted behaviors.

subsubthemes.name: Making training stable and robust to mistakes
subsubthemes.gist: These papers help reinforcement learning stay stable during training, handle bad data or reward noise, and work reliably in messy real-world conditions.

subsubthemes.name: Reasoning with images, video, and multimodal inputs
subsubthemes.gist: These papers extend reinforcement learning beyond text to help language models reason over images, videos, and dialogue, solving visual understanding tasks through trial and feedback.
